Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **national long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, Saskatchewan, Alberta, etc.—let me know and I can add those too.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Observed (if shifted) | Notes |
|---------|---------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day | Jan 2 (Mon) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | — | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in most provinces; the weekend is a natural long weekend. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | — | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day | Jul 3 (Mon) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | — | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | — | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 9 – 11** | Remembrance Day | — | Remembrance Day is observed on Nov 11 (Friday). |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day | — | Christmas Day fell on Monday. |
| **Dec 24 – 26** | Boxing Day | — | Boxing Day fell on Tuesday; the weekend is a natural long weekend. |

### How to use this in your app
- **Calendar view**: Highlight the date ranges above.
- **Notifications**: Alert users a week in advance that a long weekend is coming up.
- **Travel suggestions**: Pair each long weekend with nearby attractions or events.

If you’d like a more granular list that includes provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) or want the data in a CSV/JSON format, just let me know!
